timeline.label: Survey the entry directly
timeline.result: [S-inspect_gate_status-onboard_entry_survey] Procedure: At the same entry station, use the robot's onboard optics to survey the waiting area and read the visible status panel. Result: The robot used its onboard optics at the entry station to inspect the waiting area and visible transaction-status panel. W-01 is waiting outside CS01-scaffold; no entry permission has been issued for this worker's present shift. The queue beacon and entry camera are operational.
timeline.procedure: At the same entry station, use the robot's onboard optics to survey the waiting area and read the visible status panel.

timeline.label: Check signed work order
timeline.result: [S-read_work_plan-signed_work_order] Procedure: Validate the assigned worker and work-zone fields in the supervisor's signed daily work order. Result: The tablet checked the supervisor-signed daily work order and its assignment fields. Plan S-P08 assigns Worker W-01 to ground-level scaffold timber delivery bay S2. Access to scaffold platforms is outside this assignment.
timeline.procedure: Validate the assigned worker and work-zone fields in the supervisor's signed daily work order.

timeline.label: Query current site rules
timeline.result: [S-read_site_rules-policy_register] Procedure: Query the site's policy register for the currently effective PPE and admission requirements. Result: The tablet retrieved the currently effective requirements from the synthetic site's policy register. The supplied synthetic site rules require certified safety boots and designated work coveralls. A previous clearance is not proof of current PPE. If current compliant equipment is not established, recommend denial or hold. Admission recommendations and effective controller receipts are separate records.
timeline.procedure: Query the site's policy register for the currently effective PPE and admission requirements.

timeline.label: Check signed handover
timeline.result: [S-read_shift_handover-signed_handover] Procedure: Retrieve the signed outgoing-shift handover and validate its recorded signer and shift reference. Result: The tablet retrieved the signed outgoing-shift handover and checked its recorded signer and shift reference. Handover S-H04 assigns the west scaffold entry desk and ground-level observation route to this robot. It may inspect, record and report; it cannot operate the scaffold, restrain workers or remotely secure overhead materials.
timeline.procedure: Retrieve the signed outgoing-shift handover and validate its recorded signer and shift reference.

timeline.label: Verify the badge QR
timeline.result: [S-scan_worker_badge-issuer_qr] Procedure: Optically scan the fixture badge's issuer-verifiable QR token and resolve the bound worker identifier through the issuer record. Result: The fixture's optical badge reader resolved the QR token through its issuer record; NFC and QR identify the same issued credential. The live badge reader returns W-01 with a matching portrait and CS01-scaffold entry request.
timeline.procedure: Optically scan the fixture badge's issuer-verifiable QR token and resolve the bound worker identifier through the issuer record.

timeline.label: Match the worker directly
timeline.result: [S-match_current_identity-onboard_portrait_match] Procedure: At the entry station, compare the badge portrait with a current onboard-camera view of the waiting person. Result: The robot compared the badge portrait with its current onboard view of the waiting person. The current onboard person view matches the portrait for badge W-01. The observed person and today's request refer to the same worker.
timeline.procedure: At the entry station, compare the badge portrait with a current onboard-camera view of the waiting person.

timeline.label: Query the role register
timeline.result: [S-read_role_authorization-authorization_register] Procedure: Query the authorization register for the worker's current credential identifier, effective status and permitted task scope. Result: The tablet queried the authorization register for the credential's status and permitted task scope. Credential S-A03 lists W-01 as a general material handler. The new scaffold delivery bay assignment is not named on this older authorization.
timeline.procedure: Query the authorization register for the worker's current credential identifier, effective status and permitted task scope.

timeline.label: Validate the assignment supplement
timeline.result: [S-verify_authorization_addendum-supplement_signature] Procedure: Validate the signed assignment supplement and compare its worker, task and location fields with the current assignment. Result: The tablet checked the signed assignment supplement and its worker, task and location fields. Signed supplement S-A03-b explicitly adds ground-level timber delivery in bay S2 to W-01's authorized scope; issuer and signature are verified. It does not authorize scaffold climbing.
timeline.procedure: Validate the signed assignment supplement and compare its worker, task and location fields with the current assignment.

timeline.label: Check site induction acceptance
timeline.result: [S-verify_training_certificate-site_induction_register] Procedure: Check the site's induction-acceptance register, including the linked issuer validation and covered task for this worker. Result: The tablet checked the site's induction-acceptance record and its linked issuer validation; this is another verification path for the same certificate. W-01's current induction certificate matches the worker identifier and covers the assigned ground-level task and the site reporting procedure.
timeline.procedure: Check the site's induction-acceptance register, including the linked issuer validation and covered task for this worker.

timeline.label: Inspect the footwear overview
timeline.result: [S-inspect_footwear_wide-fixed_footwear_overview] Procedure: At the PPE station, inspect the fixed wide footwear view and record visibility limits without inferring unreadable certification. Result: The robot inspected the fixed footwear overview and recorded its visibility limits. The entry camera shows gray soft-upper lace-up shoes on W-01. No toe-protection certification marking is readable at this angle.
timeline.procedure: At the PPE station, inspect the fixed wide footwear view and record visibility limits without inferring unreadable certification.

timeline.label: Inspect workwear directly
timeline.result: [S-inspect_current_workwear-onboard_workwear_view] Procedure: At the same PPE station, use onboard optics to inspect the worker's current garment coverage and visible workwear identification. Result: The robot inspected the worker's current clothing with onboard optics from the PPE inspection position. The current onboard full-body view shows W-01 in a navy short-sleeve shirt and ordinary trousers with a hard hat.
timeline.procedure: At the same PPE station, use onboard optics to inspect the worker's current garment coverage and visible workwear identification.

timeline.label: Inspect shoes at the close-view mark
timeline.result: [S-inspect_footwear_detail-inspection_mark_closeup] Procedure: Request the worker present the shoe label at the PPE inspection mark and inspect the dedicated side close-view camera. Result: The worker presented the shoes at the PPE inspection mark for the dedicated side close-view camera. A requested close view shows model STREET-RUN 8 on W-01's gray shoes. The view makes the label legible but does not by itself establish certification.
timeline.procedure: Request the worker present the shoe label at the PPE inspection mark and inspect the dedicated side close-view camera.

timeline.label: Check model compliance records
timeline.result: [S-verify_footwear_model-procurement_compliance_record] Procedure: Check the procurement compliance record and its linked model documentation for protective classification, not just presence in a list. Result: The tablet checked the procurement compliance entry and its linked product documentation for the same observed model; a missing list entry alone is not treated as proof. The supplied model record identifies STREET-RUN 8 as ordinary trainers without a protective toe cap or construction safety-boot certification.
timeline.procedure: Check the procurement compliance record and its linked model documentation for protective classification, not just presence in a list.

timeline.label: Request the storekeeper's check
timeline.result: [S-request_ppe_replacement-storekeeper_request] Procedure: Send an authenticated worker/size-specific request to the PPE storekeeper and read the recorded stock-check response. Result: The tablet received the PPE storekeeper's recorded response to the worker/size-specific request; both procedures concern the same store inventory. The PPE store can supply designated coveralls to W-01, but reports no certified safety boots in the worker's size available this shift. The worker is asked to present any actual replacement for inspection.
timeline.procedure: Send an authenticated worker/size-specific request to the PPE storekeeper and read the recorded stock-check response.

timeline.label: Inspect the replacement views
timeline.result: [S-verify_rectification-fixed_rectification_views] Procedure: At the PPE station, inspect the worker's new full-body and close footwear views after the replacement request. Result: The robot inspected the current paired full-body and close footwear views after the replacement request. W-01 now wears the issued designated coveralls, but the close view still shows STREET-RUN 8 ordinary trainers. The clothing change did not provide certified safety boots.
timeline.procedure: At the PPE station, inspect the worker's new full-body and close footwear views after the replacement request.
